create_environment_with_gym_env: create an Environment instance wrapping a gym environment with optional fixed seed for reproducibility
run_environment_initial: run the initial method to reset the environment and get the first formatted frame with zeroed reward and done tensors
step_environment_with_action: step the environment with a torch action tensor to get the next frame, reward, and done status
format_frame_to_tensor: format a numpy frame into a PyTorch tensor with time and batch dimensions prepended
close_environment: close the underlying gym environment to release resources
